about.heading: In the game for over 6 years, I'm currently based in Ho Chi Minh city, working as an independent designer since July, 2022.

left.heading: Experience & Innovation
left.content: I've spent 6+ years designing consumer-facing products, from high-stakes commerce flows to complex logistics dashboards. My process starts with research, moves through systems thinking, and ends in interfaces that earn trust under real-world pressure.

right.heading: Creative Expertise
right.content: With over a decade of design expertise, we create tailored solutions that engage audiences, build meaningful connections, and elevate brands with creativity and intent.

journey.heading: Education & Experiences
journey.content: Web design is evolving rapidly, and I strive to stay ahead. Emerging tools and technologies enable me to create visually stunning and seamlessly functional websites.
